findings.evidence: "A good title names the area, the failing behavior and the trigger" repeats familiar bug-reporting advice; the severity table similarly restates standard definitions such as "Low | Cosmetic or copy issue with no functional effect". Across the line-weighted sections, useful activation guidance remains substantial alongside the stronger domain-specific oracles and local workflow rules.
findings.fix: Condense the generic title guidance and standard severity definitions into brief activation reminders. Retain the output template, impact-versus-rate crash distinction, Unknown-rate handling, explicit priority defaults and security/data-loss exception.

findings.evidence: "Then list every flag in the logged command with its value, one per line" is mandatory for every supplied-log review, followed by "quote each supplied field's actual value back" on exit 0 and explanations of all four exit-code branches. This prescribes exhaustive, duplicated reporting even when the command and artifact agree.
findings.fix: Keep source-to-command and source-to-file verification mandatory, but default the reply to the observed exit code and manifest, discrepancies with quoted values, and Open Questions. Make the complete flag-by-flag and saved-field audit optional when explicitly requested or needed to explain a mismatch; describe recovery for the observed exit code rather than every possible code.
